# Panda Federation

> Public-data MCP servers, Apify Actors, local-first apps and services. Official site: https://pandafederation.com/

Use WebMCP tools on this site when a browser or scanner exposes document.modelContext (list_servers, list_tools, search_tools, get_install_command, get_links, list_actors, list_apps, list_editions). The machine-readable catalog is https://pandafederation.com/webmcp-catalog.json — tool counts come from that file so they cannot drift from the listings.

## MCP servers (v0.2.0 focused, umbrella v1.8.0)

- Panda Research Tools (8): `uvx --from panda-federation-tools panda-research-tools` — citations, literature, PubMed, experts, PDF tables, Wayback, topic trends. https://github.com/pandadad0214/panda-research-tools
- Panda Public Funding Tools (10): `uvx --from panda-federation-tools panda-public-funding-tools` — grants, contracts, SAM.gov, SBIR/STTR, SEC, trials, Federal Register, recalls, VIN, EU TED. https://github.com/pandadad0214/panda-public-funding-tools
- Panda Leads Tools (15): `uvx --from panda-federation-tools panda-leads-tools` — NPI, podcasts, local businesses, hiring, enrichment, teams, trucking, nonprofits, permits, new FL/TX/NY/CO businesses, H-1B, France. https://github.com/pandadad0214/panda-leads-tools
- Panda Web Security Tools (7): `uvx --from panda-federation-tools panda-web-security-tools` — email security, AI/SEO audit, hidden-AI scanner, WHOIS, broken links, change monitor, RSS. https://github.com/pandadad0214/panda-web-security-tools
- Panda Federation Tools umbrella (40): `uvx panda-federation-tools` — prefer a focused server for new installs. https://pandadad0214.github.io/panda-federation-tools/
- Quiet File Team MCP (6, offline, no token): `uvx --from git+https://github.com/pandadad0214/quiet-file-team-mcp.git@v0.1.0 quiet-file-team-mcp` — https://pandafederation.com/quiet-file-team-mcp/

Focused servers need an `APIFY_TOKEN`. Sources are official or public. Actors bill pay-per-result.
